We offer discounts on stays of three nights or more when booked directly with us. Ask for a quote on WhatsApp.

Rates are per room per night, inclusive of up to two guests. Rates include government service fees, taxes, and breakfast.
Contact us to inquire about special rates for Indonesian residents.

Silakan hubungi resepsionis melalui WhatsApp di +62 821 4419 1647 untuk harga khusus warga negara Indonesia.

Airport and Ferry Transfers

We can assist you with ground transportation from Poto Tano ferry port (about 30 minutes from the resort) or Sumbawa Besar airport, Sultan Muhammad Kaharuddin III Airport (about 2 hours 15 minutes). Send us your flight or ferry time and we’ll arrange the pickup.

Group Bookings

We welcome groups of up to 20 people who want to stay, dive and adventure with us!
Please email bookings@moceanbeachresort.com with the subject “group inquiry” to discuss the details of your inquiry.

Maximum dive guide-to-diver ratio is one-to-four and dive times range from 45 to 65 minutes.

children.html:
Is breakfast included in the room rate?

Yes. Every room rate includes breakfast for two, plus government tax and service.

Is there a discount for longer stays?

Yes. Stays of three nights or more booked directly with us get a discount. Message us with your dates for the exact rate.

How much is a boat dive?

A two-tank boat dive costs IDR 2,200,000, or IDR 2,750,000 to Kenawa. A third boat dive is IDR 990,000. Full gear rental is IDR 330,000 a day.

Can you pick me up from the airport or ferry?

Yes. We arrange pickups from Sumbawa Besar airport and Poto Tano ferry port. Contact us with your arrival time and group size for the price.

Do I need dive insurance?

Yes. We ask for proof of dive insurance before you arrive.
